snippet_primary: "I certainly don't recommend purchasing anything from this company because you can't take a complaint to a real person directly by phone, email or text. I was scammed in relation to a supplement I bought & there was just no way to quickly query this without going through a ridiculous procedure. Furthermore, ETSY should vet these supplement sellers before accrediting them - in this case it was a bogus company not located in the country ETSY said it was; the product was not sent from the country ETSY said it would be; & the parcel labels showed it was sent from China while the parcel tracking showed it was en route from Thailand (which it wasn't!)."
subject_exact: Compra de un suplemento descrita como estafa: sin vía de queja con persona real (teléfono, email o texto), empresa no ubicada en el país que ETSY indicó, producto no enviado desde el país indicado, etiquetas de envío desde China y tracking desde Thailand
local_qualifiers: without going through a ridiculous procedure
parser_notes: 'ETSY' aparece en mayúsculas en el original; se normaliza a 'Etsy' en platforms.
'supplement' (producto físico) sin mapeo en el enum de product_type; se registra unknown.
